{{Quote|The jungle barbarians have not been around for more than three hundred years. Their language was long ago absorbed by the mountain Mooloolian tribes&mdash;|C-3PO|<ref name="Vector" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' of jungle barbarians inhabited [[Janguine]],<ref name="CSWE 1">{{CSWECite|II|138|Janguine}}</ref> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They shared the planet with the [[Mooloolian]] tribes, which occupied the [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] regions of the planet.<ref name="Vector" /> The jungle barbarians eventually vanished, and their [[Janguine (language)|language]] was absorbed by the Mooloolian tribes<ref name="CSWE 2">{{CSWECite|II|329|Mooloolian}}</ref> by [[275 BBY]].<ref name="275 BBY">{{CSWECite|II|329|Mooloolian}} establishes the Mooloolian absorbed the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the jungle barbarians 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the beginning of to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', including [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] speculation about the [[Language/Legends|language]], to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] speculated that the language of the jungle barbarians was related to [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|that]] used by a newly encountered [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]];<ref name="Vector" /> however, the speculation later proved groundless as the Yuuzhan Vong's origins were [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]].<ref name="HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[R. A. Salvatore]] created the jungle barbarians for his novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[1999]].<ref name="Vector" /> The [[2008]] reference work ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later specified that the barbarians were a distinct species.<ref name="CSWE 2" />
